messages:
Nadia: FYI a customer hit duplicate POSTs from our async python client when their network flapped. looks like retries replayed without idempotency header.
Tom: Ugh. Is this the same issue as the sync client bug we fixed last month?
Nadia: Different surface. Sync preserves headers in the RetryTransport. Async transport has a tiny refactor where _retry_request() builds a new aiohttp.Request and forgets user_headers.
Priya: Can we get a minimal repro?
Nadia: posted gist: https://gist.mock/repro_async_replay - snippet shows async client call with idempotency_key kwarg, server logs show two distinct requests because header missing on retry.
Tom: Also noticed typing complaints in the async client: mypy raises "Argument of type 'str' not assignable to parameter 'idempotency_key'" in client.post call. typing for idempotency_key is Optional[bytes] somehow. That mismatch might be from the transport refactor.
Priya: Oof. So two separate but related regressions: headers dropped on retry, and type signature mismatch. both likely from the same PR that homogenized request models.
chris-ci: ci/regressions: tests/test_async_retries.py::test_replay_with_idempotency failed on main. logs attached.
Nadia: suggested fix plan:
- ensure retry builder copies headers + metadata (preserve Idempotency-Key and any `idempotency_key` arg mapping)
- change async type annotations to accept Union[str, bytes] or just str and convert to bytes at transport boundary
- align async retry defaults with sync (use exponential backoff full jitter, max_attempts=4)
- add opt-in allow_replay boolean for non-idempotent POSTs (default False)
Tom: add unit tests: one to assert header preserved, one for mypy typing (we have a small typing CI job). Also integration test that simulates a ConnectionReset then 200 and asserts only one server-side effect when idempotency present.
Priya: docs-bot: please remember to update docs/py/advanced/retries.md and examples/async_idempotency.py with a note about idempotency_key usage and tokenization of keys.
docs-bot: noted. created docs task DOCS-512.
Nadia: I'll open PR with small change to _retry_request copying header map and update type hints. tagging @Tom for review.
Tom: thanks. also add a metric sdk.retries.replayed_count and tag `idempotency:present|missing`. we can alert if replayed_count > X/day.
Priya: can we add a debug log when a retry is suppressed due to missing idempotency? helps customers debug duplicates.
Nadia: yes, will log at DEBUG with trace id and route.
chris-ci: rerun queued tests after patch lands.
Tom: minor follow-up: consider raising a clear exception if user sets allow_replay=True for POST without idempotency key to make the risk explicit.
Nadia: agreed. PR coming in ~30m.
